content: We have IR spectrum with a peak at 1739 cm-1, typical carbonyl stretch. Need number of carbonyl groups. Could be more than one carbonyl; IR only shows one strong carbonyl peak. Could retrieve carbonyl count via other spectra like 13C NMR maybe shows carbonyl carbon signals around 190-210 ppm. Let's get carbon NMR.
